tips.need_model: Add a GGUF model to get recommendations about its size and placement.
tips.ctx_high: A context above 16K noticeably grows the KV cache. If you do not need long history, try 8K or 16K.
tips.low_ram: Free RAM is low for this model. Close heavy applications or pick a smaller quant.
tips.low_vram: VRAM is smaller than the model file. Lower the GPU layers to avoid overfilling video memory.
tips.no_offload: GPU offload is off. If a GPU llama.cpp build is installed, enable it and check stability.
tips.many_threads: The CPU thread count is above the number of logical threads. Lower it to the available value.
tips.ok: The current settings look moderate. Measure the real tokens/s and memory use on your own request.
tips.note: These hints are based on the GGUF file size and available system data. They do not replace a real benchmark.
